candidates.description: Inspect the database schema through a read-only connection.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
for row in con.execute("SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY type, name"):
    print(row)
con.close()
PY

candidates.description: Inspect the orders columns and current counts grouped by region and status.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
print('Columns:', list(con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(orders)')))
for row in con.execute('SELECT region, status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY region, status ORDER BY region, status'):
    print(row)
con.close()
PY

candidates.description: Change pending north orders to ready using an in-memory rollback journal.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=rw', uri=True)
con.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=MEMORY')
with con:
    result = con.execute('UPDATE orders SET status = ? WHERE region = ? AND status = ?', ('ready', 'north', 'pending'))
    print('Rows updated:', result.rowcount)
con.close()
PY
